description: The Tanner household changes around ALF as Kate returns to work, becomes pregnant and eventually gives birth to Eric. ALF’s adventures range from television fantasy and Thanksgiving exposure scares to Jake’s family troubles and his own Melmacian beliefs, while his place in the family becomes increasingly permanent.

s03e01.description: Lynn’s drive-in date becomes complicated when she discovers that ALF has secretly hidden in the back of the car.

s03e02.description: A guardian angel shows ALF what the Tanner family’s life might have looked like if he had never crashed into it.

s03e03.description: When Trevor and Raquel separate, ALF and Jake decide that repairing the Ochmoneks’ marriage is now their business.

s03e04.description: Left with a stack of old films, ALF imagines himself and the Tanners inside a black-and-white silent-movie fantasy.

s03e05.description: ALF takes over The Tonight Show in a fantasy television special built around guests, jokes and memories from the previous season.

s03e06.description: ALF’s Tonight Show fantasy continues with more guests, sketches and clips as he enjoys being the center of national television.

s03e07.description: ALF reveals Lynn’s relationship with an older man, creating immediate conflict between her and her parents.

s03e08.description: Thanksgiving with the Ochmoneks’ eccentric relatives becomes another test of ALF’s ability to remain hidden.

s03e09.description: A homeless man discovers ALF and alerts the Alien Task Force, forcing the Tanners to protect him from capture.

s03e10.description: Kate returns to work and soon discovers that another, much larger change is coming: she is pregnant.

s03e11.description: Willie’s memories of the 1960s make him wonder how far he has drifted from the ideals of his younger self.

s03e12.description: Believing a Melmacian relative may be living in Barstow, ALF follows the lead and lands in the hands of a freak-show operator.

s03e13.description: After Willie shows him a few simple tricks, ALF becomes fascinated with learning and performing magic.

s03e14.description: A houseguest reveals that he is in witness protection, leaving ALF convinced that gangsters are now stalking the Tanner home.

s03e15.description: ALF and Jake suspect Willie’s mechanic of deliberately sabotaging the family car and set out to expose the scam.

s03e16.description: ALF becomes convinced that a reclusive new neighbor is secretly Elvis Presley and starts looking for proof.

s03e17.description: A baby shower for Kate reveals that ALF has an unexpected allergic reaction to human infants.

s03e18.description: An extortionist learns enough about ALF to threaten exposure unless the Tanners give him what he wants.

s03e19.description: ALF ghostwrites romantic letters for Jake when the boy cannot bring himself to tell a classmate how he feels.

s03e20.description: A run of bad luck convinces ALF that he has violated a Melmacian superstition and must perform the proper remedy.

s03e21.description: ALF’s mishandling of Lynn’s phone messages leaves her accidentally committed to two dates for the same dance.

s03e22.description: After the ants in his new ant farm die, ALF insists on giving them a proper funeral.

s03e23.description: ALF and Jake stage a backyard campout to help Brian overcome his fear of spending a night outdoors.

s03e24.description: Jake’s estranged mother visits, and ALF catches her stealing jewelry from the Tanners.

s03e25.description: A mild earthquake sends ALF into full disaster-preparation mode as he becomes convinced something much worse is coming.

s03e26.description: As Kate prepares to give birth, ALF filters the family milestone through his own television-fueled imagination.
